title: Derivatives: forwards, futures, options and swaps
audience: a college student in a finance, accounting or business degree program, or a career changer studying the same material on their own
purpose: Price forwards and futures by no-arbitrage, hedge with futures, value interest-rate and currency swaps, explain option payoffs and strategies, price options with binomial trees and Black-Scholes-Merton, compute and use the Greeks, and understand how derivatives are used and misused.
primary_reading: Options Industry Council: free options education

weeks.11: Exotic options and Monte Carlo pricing

blocks.deliverable: Price five forwards and find an arbitrage.
Draw the payoffs of four option strategies.
Week 7 midterm; price an option on a two-step tree.
Simulate a delta hedge in Python.
Price an option by Monte Carlo simulation.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Hedging project: for a described company exposed to a commodity price and a currency, design hedges with futures, forwards and options, price them with the course models in Python, compare outcomes under five scenarios, and write a two-page recommendation.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.

files.L11.txt: Exotic options and Monte Carlo pricing
